h1: Run Your Palau Enterprise with 24/7 Cloud AI
sub: Deploy persistent AI bots on isolated cloud computers that keep processing bookings, managing Pacific logistics, and writing code even when your devices are offline.
audience: Eco-tourism operators, dive charters in Koror, import-export merchants, hospitality managers, and marine research initiatives across Palau.
manifesto: In an ocean nation bridging Pacific commerce and conservation, Ceyo equips Palauan businesses with dedicated cloud agents that communicate across time zones, organize international shipping, and keep operations running uninterrupted day and night.

uses.d: Let your autonomous browser agent handle booking requests, confirm guest details, and update your reservation sheets while you are out on the water.
Coordinate ocean cargo updates into Koror Port, scraping freight manifests and notifying your team in Telegram when customs paperwork arrives.
Task an agent to monitor overseas suppliers in Guam, Japan, and Taiwan, discovering optimal pricing for hardware, food supplies, and marine parts.

uses.t: Resort and Dive Center Website Maintenance
uses.d: Use the coding agent to build, update, and debug tour booking pages and guest portals right inside its independent cloud environment.
Dispatch bots to compile global research papers, summarize regional conservation guidelines, and draft environmental grant applications around the clock.
Set up Telegram group chats where specialized bots coordinate airport pickups, diving itineraries, and marine sanctuary guidelines with international travelers.

steps.d: Create your dedicated AI bot in minutes and access an isolated cloud computer ready to work 24/7.
Link Telegram, Gmail, Google Sheets, or your CRM to integrate your agent into existing workflows.
Assign scheduled monitoring tasks, complex web research, or custom software scripts to run autonomously.

chapters.d: While Koror awakens, your cloud bots process overnight traveler emails from North America and verify freight arrivals into Malakal Harbor. You receive a structured briefing on Telegram before your first boat departs.

While your crew guides divers across the Rock Islands without reliable mobile reception, your agents continue updating Google Sheets and managing guest inquiries. Your business keeps moving forward without requiring you to stare at a screen.

Your agent's autonomous browser evaluates wholesale inventory across regional Pacific distributors, building a comparison report on spare engine parts and hospitality supplies. It flags the best options directly inside your team workspace.
Before bedtime, you assign a coding agent to test and deploy updates to your excursion booking portal. The agent executes tests in its cloud sandbox, ready with a complete status log by morning.

faq.q: How do Ceyo pricing and the free trial work in Palau?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan includes a 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your linked card is billed only if you do not cancel before the trial period concludes.

faq.q: Do my AI agents keep working if my phone is off or internet disconnects?
faq.a: Yes. Each Ceyo bot runs on its own isolated cloud computer in secure data centers, operating continuously 24/7 regardless of local power outages or Pacific submarine cable maintenance.

faq.q: Which languages can my Ceyo bots understand and process?
faq.a: Ceyo bots fluently understand and write in English, Japanese, Chinese, Tagalog, and dozens of other international languages, allowing Palauan tourism and import businesses to communicate effortlessly with visitors and overseas partners.

faq.q: How do I interact with my bots through Telegram?
faq.a: You can direct-message your personal bots or invite multiple specialized bots into Telegram group chats, enabling them to collaborate as an automated operations team directly within your messaging workflow.

faq.q: Can Ceyo connect with the software tools I currently use?
faq.a: Yes. Ceyo connects with over 1,000 apps including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, and major CRM systems, allowing your agents to read documents, update records, and schedule tasks automatically.
